## About
Legacy A Auto Repair is a family owned and operated body shop in Kendall. We handle collision repair, paint and custom paint, frame work, wheel repair, restoration, window tinting, wraps, HID, suspension and upgrades.
We work on almost all foreign and domestic cars and light trucks, and hybrids too. If you've been in an accident, we work directly with the insurance company and can help with car rental and towing while your car is with us.
Neighbors have given us a 4.3 rating across 30 Google reviews, and several mention the clear communication and quick turnaround.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body work after an accident, using up-to-date equipment with the goal of returning your car to its pre-collision condition.
- Paint and body work: Paint and body work for your car, handled right here in our Kendall shop.
- Free safety checks: A courtesy safety inspection and tire pressure checks are always free.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with a rental car and towing?
A: Yes. While your car is in our body shop, we can help with car rental and towing.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Almost all foreign and domestic cars and light trucks. We work on hybrids too.
